text:
maria: Quick check — vendor just pinged: some racks for the APAC edge order are listed as refurbished and shipped with firmware 4.1. Our standard is 4.3. They say the 4.1 builds have vendor backports; asking if we should accept and simultaneously request a quota bump for ap-southeast1-edge (4x H100). Putting an infra PR up in a minute. @procurement @oncall-sre

sam: what exactly is different in 4.1 vs 4.3? security fixes or perf patches? :thinking_face:

maria: vendor message: "minor bootloader fix + vendor thermal curve backport". No CVE listed. They attached a checksum list and serials. I'm worried about compatibility with our kernel module 0.9.2.

lee: prefer we get serials + firmware SHA before accepting. If we can't repro upgrade to 4.3 in our lab, we should decline. Refurb increases risk for SLAs.

procurement: thanks — finance will need a short risk note + delta in TCO if we reject and reprocure new racks. Also confirm if vendor honors full warranty on refurbished.

maria: good point. I've opened ENGINFRA-1234 and added vendor PDFs. PR for quota bump: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/789

maria: terraform snippet I'm planning to land to request quota (posting for visibility):
```
resource "google_compute_region_instance_template" "edge-h100" {
  name = "edge-h100-template"
  machine_type = "n1-standard-32"
  scheduling { preemptible = false }
  guest_accelerator { type = "nvidia-h100", count = 4 }
}

# quota request via gcloud:
# gcloud compute regions describe ap-southeast1 --project=infra-project
```

oncall-sre: For short term, can we route new traffic to hosted/dedicated while we validate hardware? I can open a canary route and pin model variants to dedicated nodes.

sam: also, for quota bump file a cloud support ticket + show current usage. Quick gcloud sample to collect usage: `gcloud compute region-quotas describe ap-southeast1 --project infra-project`

maria: thanks — will attach output. Vendor provided serials list. @lee can you try flashing one refurb rack in lab this afternoon? If it upgrades cleanly to 4.3 we can accept but mark as 'warranty-verified'.

lee: yes I can take one. ETA 6pm PST. If flashing fails, I'll capture dmesg and the failing steps.

procurement: I'll prepare a short note for finance: accept-if-upgrade + vendor warranty confirmation. Also asking vendor for a one-week rollback window in writing.

maria: created a short checklist in the ticket: 1) lab flash attempt 2) firmware SHA verify vs vendor list 3) warranty confirmation 4) quota ticket + PR 5) temporary canary routing.

devex-bot: Reminder: hardware-audit checklist -> https://confluence.example.com/display/Infra/Hardware+Audit :spiral_notepad:

sam: SGTM. If lab flash passes, procurement can sign off and we proceed with quota bump. If not, we escalate to procurement for replacement order. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — I'll update ENGINFRA-1234 as things move. tagging @oncall-sre for routing help when quota lands. :eyes:
